layers.name: Multicolor bitmap
layers.description: The updated background restores 8 lines from the original 16-bit artwork and adds alternate shading based on the leaf graphics from the first levels. It also recreates the Rin and Tin character sidebar from the Amiga 500 version.

layers.name: Rod-land logo
layers.description: Seven complete frames written directly to multicolor bitmap reproduce the original 16-bit systems logo animation.

layers.name: C64 Original
layers.description: Reference capture of the original C64 title screen. The original artwork was created by Robert Whitaker in 1991.
